videos.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
videos.description: BFGoodrich Young Guns winner THOMAS DICKERSON takes craftsmanship to another level with a 1967 Chevrolet C10 built almost entirely by his own hands. From its tailored chassis and hand-fabricated bed to one-off lighting, flush-mounted glass and a fully custom interior, every detail reflects a singular creative vision.

videos.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
videos.description: A severely deteriorated 1960 Porsche 356B becomes the foundation for an interpretation of an automotive icon; Pete Jackson and his team reshape the car with flowing body contours, balanced design details and a thoughtfully upgraded engine; see how ingenuity, symmetry and in-house craftsmanship preserve the Porsche's character while creating the sport compact/import performance category winner at the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: Transports viewers to remote locations while showcasing the latest gear and accessories that make the modern overland lifestyle so popular and appealing.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: The team travels to Montana to go snow biking in this winter paradise, then heads to Colorado to go on an unforgettable dirt bike tour. We also test a Cherokee Gray Wolf Black Label 22RRBL toy hauler and take it on a cross-country road trip.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: We travel to the world-famous Rocky Mountains to go on a scenic Jeep tour with a bunch of volunteers that keep our trails open. We also hit the Flagstaff Overland Expo and test Beta's 430RR dual-sport motorcycle.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: We hit St. Thomas and St. John to explore this tropical paradise in UTVs. Our crew also goes off-grid with Jesse Houston to learn about gourmet camp cooking with his Switchback Supper Club, then test Honda's CRF450RL dual-sport motorcycle.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: The team travels to Montana to test a pair of Honda Talon UTVs, then Ken Faught and Randy Commons head to Colorado to ride adventure bikes. We also test Beta's all-new Alp X dual-sport motorcycle.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: Our Ken Faught and crew head to Idaho to ride dirt bikes at the world-famous Gold Creek Lodge, then hit the Silver Kings Hard Enduro to see what this sport is all about. We top it off with a trip to the Oregon Overland Expo to check out new products.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: Our Ken Faught and Viola Bautista go overlanding on the Garden Island of Kauai. Our team also rides dirt bikes and drives UTVs in Costa Rica and tests Yamaha's impressive 700cc Tenere adventure bike.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: We head to Utah to go on an incredible off-road adventure in the world-famous Moab trail system. We also introduce you to solo traveler Chas Gardener and test Beta's impressive X-Trainer dirt bike.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: Our Ken Faught makes a 1200-mile trek to the Arctic Circle on a motorcycle, then heads to Colorado for an unforgettable UTV adventure. We also test Bonnell electric bikes and KYB's all-new truck suspension.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: Viola Bautista and Catherina Bertolino join Ken Faught at the famous Kipu Ranch in Hawaii to experience a UTV tour; we also head to Montana for a dirt bike adventure and test the No Boundaries 10.7 Overland Trailer built by Forest River.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: We head to Utah to go off-grid with an X-Games gold medalist who is also an amputee. We also test Far Out Camping Co.'s unique rig in Oregon and tell you all about Honda's Transalp adventure bike.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: We head to Baja to test a race UTV, then head to Arizona for another incredible off-road adventure. Our crew also tests Sun Lite's 14 THX toy hauler trailer. This is a cool concept that offers so much versatility.

videos.title: Off-Road Travel TV
videos.description: Our crew builds two project vehicles including a Jeep Wrangler and Mercedes Sprinter Vans. These are loaded with high-tech gadgets. We also head to Bali for unique off-road adventure and the sights will leave you breathless.

videos.title: 2026 Mint 400
videos.description: The top off-road race teams from around the world battle for fame and glory.
